description: dotnet-guard: flags skipped tests, warning and analyzer suppressions, empty catch blocks, sleeps in tests, and central package version bypasses added by Edit/Write to C#, MSBuild, and editorconfig files

hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'.cs"'*|*'proj"'*|*'.props"'*|*'.targets"'*|*'config"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dotnet-guard.py";; esac
